name: english_review_no_fields

name: english_review_only_file_fields
spec: True only when the step is a Review step (English "Review", ...) AND no field other than type "file" is on screen.

name: english_review_with_text_field
spec: True only when the step is a Review step ... AND no field other than type "file" is on screen.

name: english_review_file_plus_text_field

name: voluntary_disclosures_not_review

name: my_information_not_review

name: empty_step_not_review
spec: "Voluntary Disclosures", "My Information", "Application Questions", "Self Identify", "" are never Review.

name: step_and_keys_both_changed
spec: True only when after_step is non-empty, differs from before_step, and the page does not still show exactly the same set of field ids as before (when before_keys is non-empty).

name: empty_after_step_loading
spec: Empty after_step (loading) = false.

name: same_step_is_false
spec: Same step = false.

name: different_step_same_keys_is_false
spec: Different step but identical non-empty key set = false (the old page is still shown).

name: empty_before_keys_step_differs_is_true
spec: before_keys empty = only the step decides.
